in_marathi.name: Ilakiya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Illusion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ilakiya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ilakiya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Ila’, meaning 'goddess'. The name Ilakiya refers to the goddess of illusion, often depicted in Hindu mythology as the divine consort of Lord Shiva. She is believed to possess the power to create and manipulate Maya or the illusionary world. This name is also associated with the feminine aspects of Lord Shiva and is believed to bring grace, beauty, and mystical power.
